mechanism.claim: When at least four of six liquid alt perpetuals simultaneously enter their own causal upper-quartile completed daily high-low ranges, volatility expansion is market-wide rather than BTC-local. If BTC also has elevated realized variation, follow its completed daily displacement for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed BTC twenty-four-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: Cross-alt price candidates use return signs, residuals, rank persistence, tails, turnover, or close locations. Alt-variation compression compares cross-sectional dispersion across two intraday halves. HVCARER ignores every alt return direction and instead counts symbol-specific upper-tail full-auction range expansions as confirmation for an independently signed BTC displacement. It reuses no event set or control and uses no volume, flow, funding, OI, premium, or fitted outcome.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: both broad alt range expansion and BTC completed realized-variation rank>=0.65 directly target July-like market-wide volatility
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one conditional 03:05 UTC market-wide range-expansion confirmation clock per day is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: one exact daily 03:00 UTC decision D
features.source_window: 1440 exact coherent bars_binance one-minute rows per symbol over [D-24h,D)
features.alt_range_rank: per-symbol strict-prior midrank over at most 90 earlier source-valid daily decisions, minimum 60, current excluded
features.expansion_breadth: at least four of six alts are in range expansion; alt return signs are never computed or used
features.btc_return: log(final close/first open) over the same completed window, strict nonzero
features.btc_realized_variation: sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns, finite strict positive
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 earlier source-valid daily decisions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligible: source-valid, expansion breadth>=4, BTC variation rank>=0.65, and BTC return strict nonzero

clock.decision: exact daily 03:00 UTC after all seven completed paths are available
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes all four stages

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: market-wide symbol-specific range-expansion breadth confirming BTC displacement

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no symbol basket, range, history, rank, breadth, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
